title.en: An Act Granting a Reward in the Sum of Not More than Five Hundred Pesos to Andrea Arce, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
The municipal council of Isabela, Occidental Negros, is hereby authorized to appropriate the
sum of not more than five hundred pesos out of the municipal funds to be given as a reward to Andrea Arce in
recognition of the heroism and valor which she displayed during the encounter between the "pulahanes" and
the police force of Isabela, Occidental Negros.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 30, 1928.
